headline: My Campaign Headquarters Was So Short-Lived That I Left My Lunch In The Microwave During My Arrest
body:
I had barely finished framing my campaign portrait in the local constituency office when the support from the state’s ruling party arrived. I felt like a titan of democracy, a man destined for the ballot box. I even splurged on a premium cauliflower curry for my victory lunch, setting the microwave timer for exactly five minutes, which is just enough time to dream about a landslide victory.

But the universe, or perhaps a very efficient local police precinct, had a different timeline. Exactly three minutes into the heating cycle, the sirens started. Before my lunch could even reach a lukewarm temperature, I was being escorted out by three officers who looked remarkably well-fed, unlike myself. It is a peculiar kind of heartbreak to know that my political career ended before my meal had a chance to properly steam.

Now, sitting in the holding cell, my only concern isn't the electoral outcome or the sudden shifting of political tides. I am haunted by the fact that I left my lunch in the office microwave. By the time I am released, that curry will be an unrecognizable, dehydrated brick of yellow sorrow, much like my brief, glorious tenure as a candidate.
caption: When the political endorsement hits but the handcuffs hit faster. My lunch is currently cooling into a historical artifact. #Elections #Politics #FoodCrime #ShortestCampaign (satire)
igHook: What is the weirdest place you have ever had to abandon your lunch?
